_comment: Hand-written questions about the PDFs in sample_pdfs/. 'page' is where the answer is. 'expect_any': answer is correct if it contains at least one of these. Out-of-scope questions must be refused.

in_scope.q: How long is a day on Mars?
What are the names of the moons of Mars?
Why is Mars called the Red Planet?
What is the Great Red Spot?
What is the largest moon in the Solar System?
How long ago did the Solar System form?
According to legend, who discovered coffee?
Which port was the main centre of the coffee trade?
Why did Sufi monks drink coffee?
Who patented the first espresso machine?
In which year was the first espresso machine patented?
What is the local name of Mount Etna?
How far must visitors stay from the summit craters during eruptions?

out_of_scope: What is the population of Tokyo?
What is the capital of Australia?
How do I bake sourdough bread?
Who won the 2018 football World Cup?
What is the exact height of Mount Everest in metres?
How many moons does Saturn have?
How long is a day on Jupiter?
What is the surface temperature of Venus?
When did Mount Vesuvius last erupt?
